title: Sand Atelier
description: Lift thousands of sand grains with upward water flow. Explore a clear reactor, its distributor and gravity return, then travel to the living surface of a single grain. Adjust the flow, interrupt the pump, and watch the bed expand, settle or lose fine media.
imageAlt: The working Sand Atelier with a clear vertical sand reactor, individually animated grains, feed pump, height scale and gravity return
features: 12,000 moving grains, textured fittings & rippled water
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Illustrative hydraulics and biology · Actual demo screenshot

title: Drum Atelier
description: Follow suspended waste into an automatic drum filter. Inspect the woven screen, watch the clean-water level trigger a wash, and trace the captured solids through a stationary trough to the waste outlet.
imageAlt: The working Drum Atelier with a cutaway cylindrical screen, geared drive, six rinse nozzles, separate water levels and component explorer
features: Distinct water depths, wet finishes & waste discharge
Guided particle journey & independent cutaway layers
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Illustrative loading and hydraulics · Actual demo screenshot

title: Moving Bed Atelier
description: Explore a living biological filter, from hundreds of tumbling carriers to the protected film inside one hollow surface. Follow separate air and water circuits, open the diaphragm pump, and experiment with aeration, media loading and biological establishment.
imageAlt: The Moving Bed Atelier showing a cutaway aerated reactor with hundreds of hollow carriers, separate mechanical and return-pump bays and an interactive component explorer
features: Rippled refractive water & moving floor light
Textured carrier macro & flexing pump section
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Illustrative circulation and biology · Actual demo screenshot

title: Trickle Atelier
description: Follow a drop through a complete wet/dry circuit: overflow, drip distributor, open bio-balls, bubble baffles and return pump. Take 18 assemblies apart, then turn the power off and watch the sump receive the water above.
imageAlt: The working Trickle Atelier showing an aquarium overflow above a cutaway wet/dry tower, ribbed bio-balls, baffles, clear water levels and a component explorer
features: Wet ribs, pendant drops & polished acrylic
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Illustrative hydraulics · Actual demo screenshot

title: AquaClear Atelier
description: Take a Fluval AquaClear AC70 apart in 3D. Follow the intake, magnetic impeller and spillway, explore three filtration media, and discover what changes when water takes another lap through the filter.
imageAlt: The working AquaClear Atelier showing a cutaway hang-on-back filter, foam and ceramic media, labeled intake and a component explorer
features: Loose media, clear plastic & refractive water
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & mobile · Educational reconstruction · Actual demo screenshot

title: FiltoClear 5200 Studio
description: Open a pressurized pond filter and discover its foam stack, UV clarification core and cleaning mechanism. Follow the water through the OASE FiltoClear 5200 and explore every selectable assembly.
imageAlt: The working FiltoClear studio showing a cylindrical pond filter cut open to reveal colored foam rings and the central UV assembly
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & touch · Educational reconstruction · Actual demo screenshot

title: Inside the Reef · Filtration Studio
description: Explore the hidden support system beneath a reef aquarium. Take apart a fleece roller, protein skimmer and return pump, inspect living-rock filtration, and trace the circuit through a transparent sump.
imageAlt: The working reef filtration studio showing a transparent sump with a fleece roller, bubbling protein skimmer, live-rock chamber and return pump
note: WebGL 2 · Desktop & touch · Educational reconstruction · Actual demo screenshot
